item.title: Claude for Small Business
item.description:
📝 AnnouncementsIntroducing Claude for Small BusinessMay 13, 2026We're launching Claude for Small Business—a package of connectors and ready-to-run workflows that put Claude inside the tools small businesses depend on—to help small business owners take full advantage of AI and cross off items on the to-do list. Claude for Small Business is a toggle install that puts Claude to work inside the tools small business owners already use: Intuit Quickbooks, PayPal, HubSpot, Canva, Docusign, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365. Running your next campaign.

item.title: Avoiding and reducing microplastic false positives from dry glove contact
item.description:
📝 Avoiding and reducing microplastic false positives from dry glove contact Madeline E. Quantifying environmental microplastics requires distinguishing synthetic polymers from other naturally occurring species. However, commonly used laboratory gloves release non-volatile residues, including stearate salts, that exhibit vibrational spectra similar to microplastics.
🔗 Read more: https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2026/ay/d5ay01801c
